fields.reasoning: repoFreeBytes already honours RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES only alongside RHIZA_TEST_NOW, which Setup always sets, so a Setup default makes every daemon script hermetic in one place instead of patching ~12 scripts and relying on future scripts to remember. This matches how Setup already makes HOME, git config, time and IDs hermetic (CLAUDE.md: deterministic scripts). Setting minFree 0 per script was rejected: it is again per-script, and it would skip the guard's code path rather than feed it a known figure. The scripts that test low disk already set the variable explicitly, so they keep working unchanged.
fields.statement: The testscript Setup in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go sets RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES to a large default (1 TiB) for every script, next to RHIZA_TEST_NOW and RHIZA_TEST_SEED; scripts that exercise the low-disk guard (health, daemon-notify-disk-low) override it with env, and no script reads the host's real free disk
